newsitem.title: MEXICO: Autrey says Pemex contract extended.
newsitem.headline: Autrey says Pemex contract extended.

text.p: Mexican pharmaceutical distributor Grupo Casa Autrey said its contract with state oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) for distribution of pharmaceutical products in Pemex pharmacies had been extended for the month of September in a 35 million peso deal.
The original contract ended in August, Autrey said.

"Pemex called for a new bidding process in August, which was not fulfilled," it said. "As a result, Pemex extended its contract with Autrey for the distribution of pharmaceutical products during the month of September. Total revenues for this new distribution contract will be 35 million pesos under much more favorable terms."
Autrey said there would be a new bidding process at the end of September, in which it would participate.
